description:
Building an Earth Information Jukebox, turns NASA Earth data (temp, CO2, sea level) into sound. You can hear the planet.
Frontend covered. Need:
• Backend (Python/Node) — NASA API pipeline
• Earth science person — fact-checking data
• Demo person — final walkthrough
Other roles? Still join if ur sure u can contribute with something else for this specific challenge.
High schoolers only, anywhere. No expertise needed, just interested and willing to show up. Request if interested.
